mule.xsi:schemaLocation: http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core/current/mule.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core/current/mule-ee.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http/current/mule-http.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit/current/mule-apikit.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os/current/mule-os.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db/current/mule-db.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email/current/mule-email.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/vm http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/vm/current/mule-vm.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/secure-properties http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/secure-properties/current/mule-secure-properties.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/api-gateway http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/api-gateway/current/mule-api-gateway.xsd

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'INTAKE_RECEIVED corrId=' ++ vars.corrId ++ ' eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' txn=' ++ vars.event.transaction.transactionId ++ ' card=' ++ (vars.event.card.maskedCardNumber[-4 to -1] default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { eventId: vars.event.eventId, transactionId: vars.event.transaction.transactionId, riskScore: vars.scoring.riskScore, riskBand: vars.scoring.riskBand, status: if (vars.scoring.riskBand == "HIGH") "QUEUED_FOR_REVIEW" else "QUEUED_FOR_SCORING", correlationId: vars.corrId }

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'INTAKE_ACCEPTED corrId=' ++ vars.corrId ++ ' eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' score=' ++ vars.scoring.riskScore ++ ' band=' ++ vars.scoring.riskBand ++ ' queue=' ++ vars.targetQueue]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var nowEpoch = now() as Number var windowSec = p('risk.velocityWindowSeconds') as Number --- ((vars.velHistory default []) filter ($ > nowEpoch - windowSec)) ++ [nowEpoch]

%dw 2.0 output application/java var nowEpoch = now() as Number var windowSec = p('risk.velocityWindowSeconds') as Number --- sizeOf(((vars.velHistory default []) filter ($ > nowEpoch - windowSec)) ++ [nowEpoch])

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'SCORING_FAILURE failSafe=REVIEW eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId ++ ' type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { riskScore: vars.riskCfg.failSafeScore, riskBand: "MEDIUM", ruleHits: [], scoringFailed: true }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.corrId, receivedAt: now(), velocityCount: vars.velocityCount, scoring: vars.scoring, event: vars.event }

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'ROUTING eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' band=' ++ vars.scoring.riskBand ++ ' queue=' ++ vars.targetQueue ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]
#[output text/plain --- 'PRIORITY_FALLBACK eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' HIGH event diverted to standard queue corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]
